forcefields.name: OPLS-UA (2024 parameter file)
references: W. L. Jorgensen et al., J. Phys. Chem. B (2024), doi:10.1021/acs.jpcb.3c06602 (the parameter file)
W. L. Jorgensen, J. D. Madura, C. J. Swenson, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 106, 6638 (1984)
forcefields.source_file: the united-atom types of the 2024 OPLS parameter file (on oplsaa2024-moltemplate.json)
forcefields.notes: united atom: hydrogens on carbon fold into their carbons when it is assigned. The table parameterises the united-atom alkanes, alkenes, aromatic CH, alcohols, ethers, sulfur groups, nitriles and chloromethanes. Hydrocarbon terms it never gave (CH-CH2 torsions of branched chains, C=C-C-C and C=C torsions, bends next to an sp2 carbon) come from Jorgensen, Madura & Swenson 1984, Tables I and II (33 bends, 420 torsions; bench/ff/open/oplsua2024_supplement.json), the 2024 file's own terms kept; bends take Table I's angle with the 2024 file's force constant, torsions about C=C the 2024 file's alkene V2 (the paper holds both fixed). Ether and alcohol terms it lacks are reported as missing, not invented.

typing.evidence: CAPS united-atom rules (bench/ff/make_oplsua2024.py): CH3 typed by the carbons on its neighbour as the 1984 paper defines it; on the polymer library (DP-4 chains) 22 of 114 complete and neutral, every hydrocarbon among them (polyolefins, polybutadienes, polyisoprenes, polyisobutylene, vinyl cycloalkanes, polynorbornene); 6 ethers and alcohols lack 2024 terms; 86 left untyped (substituted aromatic C, esters, amides, halogens and other groups without a united-atom type). LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies on polypropylene, polybutadiene and cis-polyisoprene oligomers.

references: M. J. Robertson, J. Tirado-Rives, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 11, 3499 (2015)
W. L. Jorgensen, D. S. Maxwell, J. Tirado-Rives, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 118, 11225 (1996)
forcefields.license: CC BY 4.0 (the Jorgensen lab: free for anyone to use, including commercially, with attribution)

typing.evidence: CAPS's OPLS-AA rules in OPLS-AA/M's names plus the protein and terminal types (bench/typing/make_oplsaam_rules.py): the file's own topology typed as it types it, 508 / 508 atoms, its 25 residues and 11 terminal patches (bench/ff/validate_rtf_types.py --patches)

forcefields.name: CL&P (ionic liquids)
references: J. N. Canongia Lopes, A. A. H. Padua, Theor. Chem. Acc. 131, 1129 (2012)

typing.evidence: CAPS rules for CL&P's types by ion family (bench/typing/make_clandp_rules.py): CL&P's own ion files (.zmat, .xyz) typed as they type them, 1165 / 1165 atoms in 55 molecules (P111i4's two swapped labels listed; CT2 and CS, the same parameters, counted as one)

forcefields.name: CL&P DES (deep-eutectic solvents)
references: J. N. Canongia Lopes, A. A. H. Padua, Theor. Chem. Acc. 131, 1129 (2012)
W. L. Jorgensen, D. S. Maxwell, J. Tirado-Rives, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 118, 11225 (1996)

typing.evidence: CAPS rules for des.ff's types by DES component (bench/typing/make_clandp_des_rules.py): CL&P's own molecule files whose types des.ff defines (cholinium.xyz, the ammonium and phosphonium ions, Cl, Br, acetate) typed as they type them, 362 / 362 atoms in 14 molecules, each at its integer charge; 29 DES components (cholinium, ammonium, phosphonium, betaine, halides, carboxylates, urea, alcohols, diols, glycerol, carboxylic acids, levulinic acid, ketones) typed whole and neutral or at their ion charge (bench/ff/check_clandp_des_components.py); those des.ff's charges cannot make neutral (methanol, malonic and oxalic acid) left untyped

forcefields.name: OPLS-DES (Doherty & Acevedo 2018)
references: B. Doherty, O. Acevedo, J. Phys. Chem. B 122, 9982 (2018)
S. V. Sambasivarao, O. Acevedo, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 5, 1038 (2009)
W. L. Jorgensen, D. S. Maxwell, J. Tirado-Rives, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 118, 11225 (1996)
forcefields.source: the paper and its Supporting Information (Tables S1-S6, Schemes S1-S2); bench/ff/make_opls_des_doherty2018.py

typing.evidence: CAPS rules for the paper's nine molecules as the SI's Schemes S1 and S2 type them, each rule only inside its whole molecule (bench/typing/make_oplsdes_doherty2018_rules.py): choline, chloride, ethylene glycol, glycerol, levulinic, malonic and oxalic acid, phenol, urea, 102 / 102 atoms by parameters (100 by name: urea's cis H, HC, has HT's terms and is typed HT); choline +0.8, chloride -0.8, the HBDs neutral, no missing term (bench/ff/check_oplsdes_doherty2018_components.py); LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies on reline, glyceline and the other HBDs

forcefields.name: DREIDING
forcefields.version: Mayo, Olafson, Goddard 1990 (Table I and the paper's rules)
references: S. L. Mayo, B. D. Olafson, W. A. Goddard III, J. Phys. Chem. 94, 8897 (1990)
forcefields.source: the paper: J. Phys. Chem. 94, 8897 (1990), Table I (radii, angles, van der Waals) and its rules for bonds, angles, torsions, inversions and hydrogen bonds (bench/ff/make_dreiding.py)

typing.evidence: CAPS rules for the paper's labels (element and hybridisation: _3, _R, _2, _1; H___A on N or O); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies and forces (bond constants by bond order, cosine-harmonic angles, the torsion rules, planar inversions, hydrogen bonds)

forcefields.name: TraPPE-UA (alkanes, alcohols)
references: M. G. Martin, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 102, 2569 (1998)
M. G. Martin, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 103, 4508 (1999)
B. Chen, J. J. Potoff, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 105, 3093 (2001)

typing.evidence: CAPS rules for foyer's eleven united-atom types (alkane and alcohol CHn, O, H); its Ryckaert-Bellemans torsions written exactly as Fourier terms; LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies. Torsions foyer's file lacks (CHn-CH2-CH-OH and similar, C-C between branched centres) are reported missing

forcefields.name: GROMOS 54A7
references: N. Schmid et al., Eur. Biophys. J. 40, 843 (2011)
C. Oostenbrink et al., J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1656 (2004)

typing.evidence: a building-block force field: CAPS recognises the residues of aminoacids.rtp (with the termini of the .tdb files) in a structure and takes their types, charges and coded terms as pdb2gmx does; peptides of all 20 amino acids, a proline N-terminus and a glycine zwitterion give pdb2gmx's topology term for term and its energies (bench/ff/compare_pdb2gmx.py)

forcefields.name: TraPPE-UA
references: M. G. Martin, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 102, 2569 (1998)
B. L. Eggimann et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 65, 1330 (2020)
forcefields.source: the TraPPE group's own parameter tables, model by model (trappe.oit.umn.edu), each term with its paper; transcribed by bench/ff/make_trappe.py
forcefields.license: published parameters of the TraPPE papers, cited per term (no file of the site is distributed)

typing.evidence: CAPS rules for 92 TraPPE-UA site types: the database's own models typed as it types them (617 / 617 sites); every model's bonds, bends and torsions as it lists them (87 / 87 models; nine models whose own lists are inconsistent named apart); 1-4 Coulomb x 0.5 for the glycol ethers, diols, disulfides and acrylates as their models count it; LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies

forcefields.name: Oxides (Bush et al. 1994)
forcefields.version: Bush, Gale, Catlow & Battle 1994 shell-model set
references: T. S. Bush, J. D. Gale, C. R. A. Catlow, P. D. Battle, J. Mater. Chem. 4, 831 (1994)
forcefields.source: the paper's set as the UCL Database of Published Interatomic Potential Parameters gives it (bush.lib, mcc.chem.ucl.ac.uk/Potentials); transcribed by bench/ff/make_inorganic_gulp.py
forcefields.license: published parameters of the paper (no file of the database is distributed)

typing.evidence: one shell-model set for 20 cations with oxygen, typed by element (a shell on every core); every Buckingham term equals an independent transcription of the same paper; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on MgO, SrTiO3 and corundum (CORESHELL styles)

forcefields.name: ClayFF
references: R. T. Cygan, J.-J. Liang, A. G. Kalinichev, J. Phys. Chem. B 108, 1255 (2004)
forcefields.source: the paper's Table 1 (charges, Do, Ro) and Table 2 (O-H bonds, H-O-H and metal-O-H bends), p 1259, read from its page images; bench/ff/make_clayff_cygan2004.py

typing.evidence: CAPS rules by element, coordination and neighbours type the INTERFACE force field's clay models (pyrophyllite, kaolinite, muscovite, five montmorillonites; 10652 / 10652 atoms) as DL_FIELD's ClayFF typing does; a muscovite with Mg for every third octahedral Al 1241 / 1260, the other 19 the paper's obss (an O by a tetrahedral and an octahedral substitution, p 1259) where DL_FIELD has obos (bench/ff/validate_clayff_dlfield.py); LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies (metal-O-H bends through contacts)

forcefields.name: GaN (Wonglakhon & Zahn 2020)
references: T. Wonglakhon, D. Zahn, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 32, 205401 (2020)
forcefields.license: published parameters of the paper (the article is CC BY)

typing.evidence: Ga and N ions with formal charges, Lennard-Jones Ga-Ga and N-N, Born-Mayer Ga-N; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on wurtzite

forcefields.name: Alkali halides (Catlow, Diller & Norgett 1977)
references: C. R. A. Catlow, K. M. Diller, M. J. Norgett, J. Phys. C: Solid State Phys. 10, 1395 (1977)

typing.evidence: 16 halides of Li, Na, K, Rb with F, Cl, Br, I, each typed by the structure's composition; every pair term equals an independent transcription of the same table; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on NaCl and LiF

forcefields.name: Oxides (Lewis & Catlow 1985)
forcefields.version: 1985, Table 3 (shell model, method (c)(i)); O-O from Catlow 1977 (C 20.37, his potential 2's)
references: G. V. Lewis, C. R. A. Catlow, J. Phys. C: Solid State Phys. 18, 1149 (1985)
C. R. A. Catlow, Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 353, 533 (1977)

typing.evidence: 20 oxides, each a shell-model set typed by composition (tetrahedral sites and second oxidation states as overlays); every cation-O term equals an independent transcription (27 / 27); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on MgO and CaO

forcefields.name: UO2 (Catlow 1977)
references: C. R. A. Catlow, Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 353, 533 (1977)

typing.evidence: shell model for U and O; potential 1 by default, potential 2 as an overlay; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on fluorite UO2 (CORESHELL styles)

forcefields.name: TiO2 (Matsui & Akaogi 1991)
references: M. Matsui, M. Akaogi, Mol. Simul. 6, 239 (1991)

typing.evidence: rigid Ti and O ions with partial charges; Ti-Ti, Ti-O and O-O Buckingham terms from the per-atom parameters (Ti-O 16957.7 eV, 0.194 A, 12.59 eV A^6, as the widely used transcription); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on rutile

forcefields.name: SiO2 (Sanders, Leslie & Catlow 1984)
references: M. J. Sanders, M. Leslie, C. R. A. Catlow, J. Chem. Soc., Chem. Commun. 1271 (1984)

typing.evidence: rigid Si4+, shell-model O, Buckingham Si-O and O-O, the O-Si-O bend on the O shells within 1.9 A of each Si as the paper writes it (K_B (theta - theta0)^2; GULP-style files apply 1/2 K_B with the same number); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on alpha-quartz

forcefields.name: MgO (Catlow, Faux & Norgett 1976)
references: C. R. A. Catlow, I. D. Faux, M. J. Norgett, J. Phys. C: Solid State Phys. 9, 419 (1976)

typing.evidence: rigid Mg2+ and a shell-model O2-; model 1 by default, model 2 as an overlay; the perfect lattice at r0 2.106 A gives -40.82 eV per MgO (the paper: 40.85); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on rock-salt MgO with either model

forcefields.name: Rutile (Catlow, Freeman & Royle 1985)
references: C. R. A. Catlow, C. M. Freeman, R. L. Royle, Physica B+C 131, 1 (1985)

typing.evidence: Ti and O shells with harmonic and quartic core-shell springs (the quartic constant read as K w^4/24); the paper's alpha-quartz set is sanders1984-sio2; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on rutile

forcefields.name: ZrO2 (Khan, Islam & Bates 1998)
references: M. S. Khan, M. S. Islam, D. R. Bates, J. Mater. Chem. 8, 2299 (1998)

typing.evidence: Zr and O shells, formal charges, 10.254 A cut-off; cubic ZrO2 at a = 5.07 A gives -109.76 eV per ZrO2 (the paper's lattice energy); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies

forcefields.name: MgO, CaO, SrO, BaO rigid ions (Sayle & Watson 2000)
references: D. C. Sayle, G. W. Watson, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2, 5491 (2000)

typing.evidence: formal-charge rigid ions, one O for the four oxides and their interfaces, 10 A cut-off; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on MgO and BaO

forcefields.name: Ferroelectric perovskites (Sepliarsky et al. 2005)
references: M. Sepliarsky, A. Asthagiri, S. R. Phillpot, M. G. Stachiotti, R. L. Migoni, Curr. Opin. Solid State Mater. Sci. 9, 107 (2005)

typing.evidence: every ion a core and a shell with anharmonic springs c2 w^2/2 + c4 w^4/24, Buckingham pairs, each set typed by composition; PbTiO3 left out (Table 1's Pb-Ti row makes it unbound); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on KNbO3, KTaO3, BaTiO3 and SrTiO3

forcefields.name: TiO2-H2O (Bandura & Kubicki 2003)
references: A. V. Bandura, J. D. Kubicki, J. Phys. Chem. B 107, 11072 (2003)

typing.evidence: Matsui & Akaogi's rigid ions with the paper's surface charges and pairs, sites typed by neighbours (TiV, TiVI, TiVIoh, Ob, Os, Obh, Ooh), Morse O-H, Ti-O-H bends by distance, flexible SPC/E water; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on a hydroxylated rutile (110) slab with water

forcefields.name: Oxide glasses, Teter partial charges
forcefields.version: Cormack 2002, Du 2009, Okhotnikov 2013 (each term with its table)
references: A. N. Cormack, J. Du, T. R. Zeitler, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 4, 3193 (2002)
J. Du, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 92, 87 (2009)
K. Okhotnikov, B. Stevensson, M. Eden, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 15, 15041 (2013)
A. Tilocca, N. H. de Leeuw, A. N. Cormack, Phys. Rev. B 73, 104209 (2006)

typing.evidence: rigid ions with partial charges (O -1.2, Si 2.4, Al/Y/La/Lu/Sc 1.8, Na 0.6), Buckingham terms with O; Okhotnikov's own Y-O and Tilocca's Teter set (Table III, with Ca) as overlays; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on quartz, corundum and Y2O3, each overlay included

forcefields.name: Silicate glasses, shell model (Tilocca 2006)
references: A. Tilocca, N. H. de Leeuw, A. N. Cormack, Phys. Rev. B 73, 104209 (2006)

typing.evidence: formal-charge Si, Na, Ca and shell-model O; SM1's screened O-Si-O bend (CAPS and DL_POLY; LAMMPS and GROMACS have no such style), its energy on quartz equal to an independent evaluation of the paper's equation; SM0 (raw harmonic bend) as an overlay, LAMMPS reproducing CAPS's energies on quartz

forcefields.name: LiPO3 glass (Vogel 2003)
references: M. Vogel, arXiv:cond-mat/0307738v2 (2003)

typing.evidence: Li, P, O with effective charges and Born-Mayer terms for every pair; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies

forcefields.name: CaCO3 (Xiao, Edwards & Grater 2011)
references: S. Xiao, S. A. Edwards, F. Grater, J. Phys. Chem. C 115, 20067 (2011)
W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chandrasekhar, J. D. Madura, R. W. Impey, M. L. Klein, J. Chem. Phys. 79, 926 (1983)
forcefields.source: the paper's Table 1 and energy expression; bench/ff/make_xiao2011.py

typing.evidence: Ca, carbonate C and O with the paper's charges and C12/C6 pairs (Ca-O's C6 0 written as 1e-12), the O-C-O bend and the K (1 - cos 2 psi) plane term by distance (no C-O bond term, no exclusions), TIP3P water with the paper's mineral-water pairs; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on calcite and aragonite

forcefields.name: Gd pyrochlores (Gunn et al. 2012)
references: D. S. D. Gunn, N. L. Allan, H. Foxhall, J. H. Harding, J. A. Purton, W. Smith, M. J. Stein, I. T. Todorov, K. P. Travis, J. Mater. Chem. 22, 4675 (2012)

typing.evidence: rigid Gd, Ti, Zr and O ions with formal charges, Buckingham terms with O, 12 A cut-off; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on Gd2Ti2O7 and Gd2Zr2O7

forcefields.name: La perovskite oxides (Cherry 1995; Read 1999)
references: M. Cherry, M. S. Islam, C. R. A. Catlow, J. Solid State Chem. 118, 125 (1995)
M. S. D. Read, M. S. Islam, F. King, F. E. Hancock, J. Phys. Chem. B 103, 1558 (1999)

typing.evidence: shell models with formal charges: LaMO3 (M = Cr, Mn, Fe, Co) from Cherry, La2NiO4 and its 2+ dopants from Read, each set typed by composition (Ni present or not); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on LaFeO3, LaCoO3 and La2NiO4 (CORESHELL styles)

forcefields.name: Zeolites with bridging hydroxyls (Schroder et al. 1992)
references: K.-P. Schroder, J. Sauer, M. Leslie, C. R. A. Catlow, J. M. Thomas, Chem. Phys. Lett. 188, 320 (1992)
forcefields.source: the paper's Table 1 (read from the page image); bench/ff/make_schroder1992.py

typing.evidence: formal-charge Si and Al, shell-model framework O, hydroxyl O and H with the paper's fractional charges; the O-H Morse as a pair term within 1.4 A with its Coulomb term kept; O-T-O bends k (theta - theta0)^2 by distance; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on quartz and on Si(OH)4 / Al(OH)3

forcefields.name: Zeolite NaY and chloroform (Ramsahye & Bell 2005)
references: N. A. Ramsahye, R. G. Bell, J. Phys. Chem. B 109, 4738 (2005)

typing.evidence: Kramer-charge framework (Si, Al, O) with Na, Buckingham terms and O-T-O bends by distance; chloroform's charges, bonds, bends and its Lennard-Jones pairs with itself, O and Na; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on quartz and on chloroform with Na+, AlO4 and SiO4

forcefields.name: Silicalite and benzene (Forester & Smith 1997)
references: T. R. Forester, W. Smith, J. Chem. Soc., Faraday Trans. 93, 3249 (1997)

typing.evidence: Schroder and Sauer's silica shell model as the paper gives it (Si-O shell repulsion only, O-Si-O bends on the shells) and the benzene-O shell pairs (rigid benzene); LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on quartz and on benzene with SiO4

forcefields.name: Aluminosilicates (Hill & Sauer 1995)
references: J.-R. Hill, J. Sauer, J. Phys. Chem. 99, 9536 (1995)
J.-R. Hill, J. Sauer, J. Phys. Chem. 98, 1238 (1994)
forcefields.source: the paper's Table 8 (cross terms read from the page image); bench/ff/make_hill_sauer1995.py

typing.evidence: the ab initio CFF for silica and zeolite clusters: quartic bonds and angles, torsions, bond-bond, bond-angle, angle-angle and angle-angle-torsion cross terms, the bridging O's out-of-plane term, A_i A_j / r^9 repulsion and bond-increment charges; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on disilicic acid, a bridging-hydroxyl Si-O(H)-Al cluster, (HO)3Si-O-Al(OH)3 and a cyclotetrasilicic acid

forcefields.name: TraPPE-EH
forcefields.version: the TraPPE database (trappe.oit.umn.edu), explicit-hydrogen family, retrieved October 2026
references: N. Rai, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 111, 10790 (2007)
B. L. Eggimann et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 65, 1330 (2020)
forcefields.source: the TraPPE group's own parameter tables, model by model (trappe.oit.umn.edu), each term with its paper; transcribed by bench/ff/make_trappe_eh.py
forcefields.license: published parameters of the TraPPE papers, cited per term (no file of the site is distributed)

typing.evidence: the 65 TraPPE-EH models (alkanes, amines, amides, nitriles, nitro compounds, aromatics and heteroaromatics), each with its own charges: one CAPS type per symmetry class of a model, typed by a whole-molecule SMARTS (848 / 848 sites as the database types them); every model's bonds, bends and torsions as it lists them (59 / 65 models exact, the rest the database's symmetric-position differences); LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies

forcefields.name: All-atom alkanes in silicalite (O'Malley & Catlow 2013)
references: A. J. O'Malley, C. R. A. Catlow, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 15, 19024 (2013)
forcefields.source: the paper's Tables 2 and 3 (read from the page images); bench/ff/make_zeolite_sorbates.py

typing.evidence: alkane C typed by its H count (charges +0.1 per H, each alkane neutral), H, and the formal-charge silica framework (Buckingham Si-O and O-O within 10 A, O-Si-O bends by distance); the paper's torsion (Raj, Sastre & Catlow 1999) not included; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on alpha-quartz and on alkanes with SiO4, GROMACS on the alkanes

forcefields.name: Methanol in zeolite NaY (Plant, Maurin & Bell 2007)
references: D. F. Plant, G. Maurin, R. G. Bell, J. Phys. Chem. B 111, 2836 (2007)

typing.evidence: Kramer-charge NaY framework with Na (as Ramsahye & Bell), methanol's charges, bonds, bends, torsion and pairs, and its pairs with the framework O and Na; LAMMPS reproduces CAPS's energies on methanol with Na+, AlO4 and SiO4, GROMACS on methanol

forcefields.name: HFA134a (Peguin et al. 2009, FF no. 2)
references: R. P. S. Peguin, G. Kamath, J. J. Potoff, S. R. P. da Rocha, J. Phys. Chem. B 113, 178 (2009)
forcefields.source: the paper's Tables 1 (read from the page image) and 2; bench/ff/make_zeolite_sorbates.py

typing.evidence: CF3CH2F with the paper's FF no. 2 charges and Lennard-Jones terms, OPLS-AA bends and the fitted F-C-C-F and F-C-C-H torsions, no intramolecular pairs; LAMMPS and GROMACS reproduce CAPS's energies
